title: Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Undertakes Special Campaign 6 to Institutionalise Swachhata and Minimise Pendency in Government Offices
body_text:
The Department of Health and Family Welfare (DoHFW), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, is undertaking Special Campaign 6 from 2nd to 31st October 2026 with a focus on institutionalising Swachhata and minimising pendency in government offices. The Campaign is being implemented across the Department’s attached and subordinate offices, Central Government hospitals, autonomous bodies, Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUs) and other associated institutions, with an emphasis on promoting cleanliness, improving workplace management and ensuring the timely disposal of pending matters.
Pharmacy Room at CGHS Dispensary, Bengaluru
As part of the Campaign, various offices and institutions under the Department are undertaking cleanliness drives, systematic disposal of scrap and e-waste, optimal utilisation of office space and measures to expedite the disposal of public grievances and other pending matters. These initiatives aim to improve the upkeep of office premises, create cleaner and more organised work environments, and strengthen administrative efficiency through sustained and systematic efforts.
Corridor at CDSCO West Zone, Mumbai
Cleanliness activities undertaken by APHO, Mumbai
These efforts reflect the Department’s continued commitment to institutionalising Swachhata , reducing pendency and fostering a culture of cleanliness, efficiency and good governance across its offices and institutions.
